title: Home Coordinate Save+
description: This mod is Simple the copy of the Home Coordinate Save but with teleport option
body:
🏠 Home Coordinate Save+
Because walking home is overrated.

You loved the classic "Home Coordinate Save" mod? This is the plus-sized upgrade you've been waiting for – with all the simplicity of the original, but now with an extra trick up its sleeve:

✨ New Feature:
🆕 Press I → Instantly teleport to your saved home coordinates.
(Yep. No command, no portal. Just zip.)

🎮 How it works:
🔘 H — Save your current location as “home”.

🧭 K — Show your saved home coordinates on screen.

✨ I — Instantly teleport back home.

Perfect for lazy explorers, casual players, or anyone who just really hates long walks through creeper-infested forests.

🛠 Details:
Minecraft version: 1.21.4

Modloader: NeoForge

Singleplayer compatible ✅

Can be enabled in servers (if allowed) ✅

No dependencies ✅

Lightweight & clean

🧠 Notes:
You can still use it without teleporting — the basic save/view functions work as before.

The teleport feature is not OP if you use it smartly. Just don’t abuse it... or do. Who’s gonna stop you?
